eue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22master-task%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22mobile%22%2C%22codex%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22subtask%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22evidence%22%5D%7D%5D%2C%22verifiedSubtaskIds%22%3A%5B%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%5D%2C%22reply%22%3A%22%23%23%20A.%20Verified%20conclusion%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**The%20original%20RCA%20is%20now%20preserved%20in%20a%20verified%20subtask.**%20The%20master%20has%20been%20replaced%20with%20the%20cross-incident%20report%20and%20links%20the%20related%20queue%2C%20lifecycle%2C%20and%20verification%20work.%5Cn2.%20**The%20failure%20recurred%20during%20this%20audit%20across%20three%20live%20runs.**%20Android%20recorded%20three%20%60SIGABRT%60%20crashes%20with%20the%20exact%20stdout%20%60Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20message%3B%20the%20replacement%20backend%20resumed%20all%20three%20sessions%20afterward.%5Cn3.%20**The%20server%20exit%20trigger%20remains%20unverified.**%20The%20report%20does%20not%20convert%20the%20concurrent%20full%20suite%20into%20causality.%20It%20records%20the%20separate%20proven%20defect%20that%20npm-based%20suites%20bypass%20the%20three-worker%20rewrite%20and%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20during%20production%20Codex%20work.%5Cn%5Cn---%5Cn%5Cn%23%23%20B.%20Selected%20resolution%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**Finish%20one%20host-owned%2C%20direct-file%20Codex%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree.**%20Use%20one%20durable%20manifest%2C%20validated%20process-group%20cancellation%2C%20idempotent%20reconciliation%2C%20and%20no%20server-owned%20standard-stream%20pipes.%5Cn2.%20**Add%20enforceable%20mobile%20verification%20admission.**%20Reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20production%20runs%20are%20active%2C%20expose%20direct%20bounded%20commands%2C%20and%20reserve%20the%20full%20suite%20for%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window.%5Cn3.%20**Keep%20this%20master%20open.**%20Its%20acceptance%20gate%20requires%20server-independent%20thread%20and%20pipeline%20runs%2C%20exact-once%20lifecycle%20transitions%2C%20bounded%20verification%20cleanup%2C%20served%20mobile%20consistency%2C%20and%20no%20new%20Android%20broken-pipe%20crash.%22%7D'\""} -->

eue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22master-task%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22mobile%22%2C%22codex%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22subtask%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22evidence%22%5D%7D%5D%2C%22verifiedSubtaskIds%22%3A%5B%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%5D%2C%22reply%22%3A%22%23%23%20A.%20Verified%20conclusion%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**The%20original%20RCA%20is%20now%20preserved%20in%20a%20verified%20subtask.**%20The%20master%20has%20been%20replaced%20with%20the%20cross-incident%20report%20and%20links%20the%20related%20queue%2C%20lifecycle%2C%20and%20verification%20work.%5Cn2.%20**The%20failure%20recurred%20during%20this%20audit%20across%20three%20live%20runs.**%20Android%20recorded%20three%20%60SIGABRT%60%20crashes%20with%20the%20exact%20stdout%20%60Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20message%3B%20the%20replacement%20backend%20resumed%20all%20three%20sessions%20afterward.%5Cn3.%20**The%20server%20exit%20trigger%20remains%20unverified.**%20The%20report%20does%20not%20convert%20the%20concurrent%20full%20suite%20into%20causality.%20It%20records%20the%20separate%20proven%20defect%20that%20npm-based%20suites%20bypass%20the%20three-worker%20rewrite%20and%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20during%20production%20Codex%20work.%5Cn%5Cn---%5Cn%5Cn%23%23%20B.%20Selected%20resolution%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**Finish%20one%20host-owned%2C%20direct-file%20Codex%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree.**%20Use%20one%20durable%20manifest%2C%20validated%20process-group%20cancellation%2C%20idempotent%20reconciliation%2C%20and%20no%20server-owned%20standard-stream%20pipes.%5Cn2.%20**Add%20enforceable%20mobile%20verification%20admission.**%20Reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20production%20runs%20are%20active%2C%20expose%20direct%20bounded%20commands%2C%20and%20reserve%20the%20full%20suite%20for%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window.%5Cn3.%20**Keep%20this%20master%20open.**%20Its%20acceptance%20gate%20requires%20server-independent%20thread%20and%20pipeline%20runs%2C%20exact-once%20lifecycle%20transitions%2C%20bounded%20verification%20cleanup%2C%20served%20mobile%20consistency%2C%20and%20no%20new%20Android%20broken-pipe%20crash.%22%7D'"`

## A. Verified conclusion

1. **The original RCA is now preserved in a verified subtask.** The master has been replaced with the cross-incident report and links the related queue, lifecycle, and verification work.
2. **The failure recurred during this audit across three live runs.** Android recorded three `SIGABRT` crashes with the exact stdout `Broken pipe (os error 32)` message; the replacement backend resumed all three sessions afterward.
3. **The server exit trigger remains unverified.** The report does not convert the concurrent full suite into causality. It records the separate proven defect that npm-based suites bypass the three-worker rewrite and ran with `--test-concurrency=0` during production Codex work.

---

## B. Selected resolution

1. **Finish one host-owned, direct-file Codex runner before merging the active lifecycle worktree.** Use one durable manifest, validated process-group cancellation, idempotent reconciliation, and no server-owned standard-stream pipes.
2. **Add enforceable mobile verification admission.** Reject repo-wide suites while production runs are active, expose direct bounded commands, and reserve the full suite for an operator-authorized maintenance window.
3. **Keep this master open.** Its acceptance gate requires server-independent thread and pipeline runs, exact-once lifecycle transitions, bounded verification cleanup, served mobile consistency, and no new Android broken-pipe crash.

e%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22master-task%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22mobile%22%2C%22codex%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22subtask%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22evidence%22%5D%7D%5D%2C%22verifiedSubtaskIds%22%3A%5B%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%5D%2C%22reply%22%3A%22%23%23%20A.%20Verified%20conclusion%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**The%20original%20RCA%20is%20now%20preserved%20in%20a%20verified%20subtask.**%20The%20master%20has%20been%20replaced%20with%20the%20cross-incident%20report%20and%20links%20the%20related%20queue%2C%20lifecycle%2C%20and%20verification%20work.%5Cn2.%20**The%20failure%20recurred%20during%20this%20audit%20across%20three%20live%20runs.**%20Android%20recorded%20three%20%60SIGABRT%60%20crashes%20with%20the%20exact%20stdout%20%60Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20message%3B%20the%20replacement%20backend%20resumed%20all%20three%20sessions%20afterward.%5Cn3.%20**The%20server%20exit%20trigger%20remains%20unverified.**%20The%20report%20does%20not%20convert%20the%20concurrent%20full%20suite%20into%20causality.%20It%20records%20the%20separate%20proven%20defect%20that%20npm-based%20suites%20bypass%20the%20three-worker%20rewrite%20and%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20during%20production%20Codex%20work.%5Cn%5Cn---%5Cn%5Cn%23%23%20B.%20Selected%20resolution%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**Finish%20one%20host-owned%2C%20direct-file%20Codex%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree.**%20Use%20one%20durable%20manifest%2C%20validated%20process-group%20cancellation%2C%20idempotent%20reconciliation%2C%20and%20no%20server-owned%20standard-stream%20pipes.%5Cn2.%20**Add%20enforceable%20mobile%20verification%20admission.**%20Reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20production%20runs%20are%20active%2C%20expose%20direct%20bounded%20commands%2C%20and%20reserve%20the%20full%20suite%20for%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window.%5Cn3.%20**Keep%20this%20master%20open.**%20Its%20acceptance%20gate%20requires%20server-independent%20thread%20and%20pipeline%20runs%2C%20exact-once%20lifecycle%20transitions%2C%20bounded%20verification%20cleanup%2C%20served%20mobile%20consistency%2C%20and%20no%20new%20Android%20broken-pipe%20crash.%22%7D'\"","codexExitCode":"0"} -->

e%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22master-task%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22mobile%22%2C%22codex%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22subtask%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22evidence%22%5D%7D%5D%2C%22verifiedSubtaskIds%22%3A%5B%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%5D%2C%22reply%22%3A%22%23%23%20A.%20Verified%20conclusion%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**The%20original%20RCA%20is%20now%20preserved%20in%20a%20verified%20subtask.**%20The%20master%20has%20been%20replaced%20with%20the%20cross-incident%20report%20and%20links%20the%20related%20queue%2C%20lifecycle%2C%20and%20verification%20work.%5Cn2.%20**The%20failure%20recurred%20during%20this%20audit%20across%20three%20live%20runs.**%20Android%20recorded%20three%20%60SIGABRT%60%20crashes%20with%20the%20exact%20stdout%20%60Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20message%3B%20the%20replacement%20backend%20resumed%20all%20three%20sessions%20afterward.%5Cn3.%20**The%20server%20exit%20trigger%20remains%20unverified.**%20The%20report%20does%20not%20convert%20the%20concurrent%20full%20suite%20into%20causality.%20It%20records%20the%20separate%20proven%20defect%20that%20npm-based%20suites%20bypass%20the%20three-worker%20rewrite%20and%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20during%20production%20Codex%20work.%5Cn%5Cn---%5Cn%5Cn%23%23%20B.%20Selected%20resolution%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**Finish%20one%20host-owned%2C%20direct-file%20Codex%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree.**%20Use%20one%20durable%20manifest%2C%20validated%20process-group%20cancellation%2C%20idempotent%20reconciliation%2C%20and%20no%20server-owned%20standard-stream%20pipes.%5Cn2.%20**Add%20enforceable%20mobile%20verification%20admission.**%20Reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20production%20runs%20are%20active%2C%20expose%20direct%20bounded%20commands%2C%20and%20reserve%20the%20full%20suite%20for%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window.%5Cn3.%20**Keep%20this%20master%20open.**%20Its%20acceptance%20gate%20requires%20server-independent%20thread%20and%20pipeline%20runs%2C%20exact-once%20lifecycle%20transitions%2C%20bounded%20verification%20cleanup%2C%20served%20mobile%20consistency%2C%20and%20no%20new%20Android%20broken-pipe%20crash.%22%7D'"`

      "markdown": "## A. Operator conclusion\n\n1. **The recurring production failure is a closed Codex stdout pipe.** During this audit Android recorded three native Codex aborts at `23:27:22`, `23:27:25`, and `23:27:46` with `failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32)`. The affected processes were this RCA run, the Pink run, and the related lifecycle implementation run.\n2. **Decision OS recovered work after the damage instead of preserving execution through server loss.** The replacement backend started at `16:27:54` UTC and spawned resume processes for all three runs at `16:27:58` UTC. Every original Codex process had already terminated with `SIGABRT`.\n3. **The durable correction is one host-owned runner for every Codex run.** Codex standard input, JSONL output, and error output must bind directly to files; lifecycle and cancellation must use a durable manifest plus validated process identity; the HTTP server must not own Codex transport.\n\n---\n\n## B. Verified failure chains\n\n1. **Execution chain:** `runsv` owns `decision-os-server.mjs`; the launcher owns the backend child; the backend spawns a Node Codex wrapper; the wrapper spawns the Termux native binary. `start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts` still uses `stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']`, ingests stdout in Node, pipes both outputs to files, sends the prompt through Node, and settles state from child callbacks.\n2. **Crash transition:** the backend-side stdout reader disappears; the native process reaches its next JSON write; the Termux binary treats `EPIPE` as a fatal print failure; Android records `SIGABRT` in `codex-main`. Three fresh crash records prove the same transition across two projects and three independent runs.\n3. **Restart transition:** the supervisor created a replacement backend, which read the run files and session IDs and launched continuations. The replacement PIDs prove recovery; the original processes did not survive.\n4. **Unresolved initiating event:** available service logs begin with replacement startup and Android logs contain no low-memory kill record for the old backend. The reason the backend exited is not verified. This report does not assign that exit to tests, OOM, a signal sender, or a source change.\n\n---\n\n## C. Queue and concurrent-agent findings\n\n1. **Related implementation is active but not ready:** [Analyze Codex run lifecycle and status consistency](card:card-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797) has an uncommitted `codex-run-lifecycle` worktree with a new manifest, host launcher, reconciler, cancellation changes, frontend hydration changes, and `292` added plus `503` removed lines. Its focused frontend run still reported a missing `terminal-button.css` fixture, and the production server disappeared during the run.\n2. **Queue restart recovery solved a different defect:** [Recover queued Codex runs after server restart](card:card-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c) corrected a lost scheduler wake-up for durable pending items. It does not remove server-owned pipes from running Codex processes.\n3. **Verification admission remains incomplete:** [Make worktree verification one-command and environment-safe](card:card-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a) remains open. The live lifecycle agent invoked `node bin/decision-os-verify.mjs -- npm run test:front-back`, then `npm test --prefix frontend`. The wrapper sees `npm`, so its concurrency rewrite does not apply; observed workers ran with `--test-concurrency=0` while production Codex runs were active.\n4. **The suite overlap is a proven safety defect, not a proven crash cause.** The lease serializes verification commands only; it does not exclude production Codex work, cap test workers hidden behind npm scripts, or protect the serving backend.\n\n---\n\n## D. Selected correction\n\n1. **Complete the unified host-owned runner before merging the active lifecycle branch.** Open the prompt, JSONL, and error files before spawn; start Codex in its own process session with those file descriptors; persist PID, Linux start identity, process-group ID, run kind, queue order, lifecycle revision, retry timestamp, terminal status, and exit code in one manifest.\n2. **Replace child-handle lifecycle authority.** Reconcile from validated OS identity and terminal JSONL; cancel through the validated process group; make queue release, retry admission, card projection, pipeline advancement, and notification idempotent manifest transitions.\n3. **Harden the supervised server boundary.** Keep `runsv` as the single owner, make readiness follow successful `listen`, record backend exit code and signal, and refuse replacement startup while another verified port owner remains.\n4. **Make mobile verification admission enforceable.** Expand repository scripts to direct bounded test commands, reject repo-wide suites while durable Codex manifests are running, and require an operator-authorized maintenance window for the single full-suite run. The lease must terminate the complete verification process group on interruption.\n5. **Track the Termux binary defect independently.** Report the reproducible stdout `EPIPE` abort, pin the corrected build once available, and retain the direct-file runner so server survival never depends on that upstream fix.\n\n---\n\n## E. Acceptance gate\n\n1. **Server independence:** one thread run and one pipeline run continue with the same PID/start identity and growing JSONL while the backend is absent; restart creates no duplicate.\n2. **Lifecycle authority:** completion, failure, cancellation, retry, capacity release, card status, and pipeline advancement each persist exactly once and survive reload.\n3. **Mobile safety:** repo-wide verification is rejected while a production Codex manifest is running; direct tests never exceed three workers; interruption leaves no verification descendants.\n4. **Crash evidence:** Android logs show no new `failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe` entry during controlled server loss.\n5. **Merge gate:** do not merge the active lifecycle worktree until focused checks, bounded package checks, both typechecks, the maintenance-window full suite, and served mobile status consistency pass.\n\n---\n\n## F. Subtasks\n\n1. [Preserve the Original Broken-Pipe RCA](card:card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714)\n"

A. Verified discrepancy\\\\n\\\\n1. **The screenshot captured a frontend contradiction at `2026-07-16 21:26`**: the Pink task panel showed `START`, `00:00`, `0` tools, and `No Codex run for this thread` while the task was active.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n2. **The backend run existed and was live.** Pink persisted `codexActiveRunId` and `codexThreadRunId` as `codex-skill-1784211925748-5e8f0f24`; `codex-process-queue.json` recorded status `running`, PID `15662`, and JSONL/log paths; the compact status API returned `running` and `active: true`; the JSONL file continued growing.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## B. B. Root cause\\\\n\\\\n1. **The first incorrect transition is the mobile post-launch refresh.** `refreshThreadLedger()` updates only `currentCard` from the refreshed canvas at `frontend/src/app/responsive/thread.js:145-146`.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n2. **The renderer reads a different object.** `renderThreadPanel()` and `renderThreadCodexLog()` resolve the card from `canvasState.activeLedger` at `frontend/src/runtime/thread/effect/render-thread-panel.ts:214-224` and `frontend/src/runtime/thread/effect/render-thread-codex-log.ts:148-165`.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n3. **`canvasState.activeLedger` remains the pre-launch ledger.** The newly created intake flow opens the thread with the locally created card. The backend persists run ownership before launch at `backend/src/business/codex/controller/start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts:259-269`, but the refreshed ledger is never installed as the shared frontend source of truth. Control Room reads the persisted projection independently, which explains the simultaneous active task and empty thread log.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## C. C. Runtime architecture finding\\\\n\\\\n1. **Thread Codex is detached in name but server-owned in behavior.** It is spawned with `stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']`; Node ingests stdout, pipes stdout and stderr into files, feeds stdin, owns settlement callbacks, schedules capacity retries, releases the queue, clears card ownership, and publishes completion at `backend/src/business/codex/controller/start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts:315-413`.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n2. **The partial restart refactor persists identity without removing transport coupling.** Commit `e74bb7c` added PID/start-time records and adoption. Recovery polls `/proc` and JSONL from a server timer at `backend/src/business/codex/helper/codex-process-queue.ts:267-351`. Adopted thread runs cannot be cancelled because cancellation requires the in-memory `ChildProcess` at `backend/src/business/codex/controller/cancel-card-skill-run-controller.ts:49-61`.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n3. **Pipeline runs have a second lifecycle implementation.** They use server-owned pipes without detachment or durable PID registration at `backend/src/business/codex/helper/codex-pipeline-runner.ts:429-484`. After restart, a running pipeline skill without an in-memory child is classified terminal or failed at `backend/src/business/codex/helper/resume-codex-pipeline-runs.ts:26-47`.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n4. **There are currently three competing authorities:** card run pointers, durable queue/pipeline records, and `runtime.codexSkillRuns` plus `ChildProcess`. Status, capacity, cancellation, recovery, and UI projections select different subsets.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## D. D. Architecture decision\\\\n\\\\n1. **Use one durable run manifest for every thread, continuation, and pipeline skill.** Persist run ID, project, ledger, card, kind, queue order, model, effort, prompt path, JSONL path, log path, PID, Linux start identity, process-group ID, lifecycle revision, timestamps, retry time, terminal status, exit code, and error.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n2. **Launch Codex as a host-owned process session.** Open the prompt, JSONL, and log files before launch; start Codex in a new session with those file descriptors; detach and unreference it immediately. No Codex stdout, stderr, stdin, settlement callback, retry timer, or child handle remains attached to the HTTP server.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n3. **Make the manifest plus OS liveness the lifecycle authority.** Reads reconcile manifest state with PID/start identity and terminal JSONL events. Dead processes without a terminal event become `interrupted`; durable `retryAt` drives continuation admission. Cancellation signals the persisted process group after validating PID/start identity.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n4. **Keep the HTTP server as an API and projection consumer.** It may tail files to publish UI refresh events, but event delivery does not own execution or truth. Server restart reconstructs projections from manifests and never relaunches a process that is still alive.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## E. E. Ordered implementation\\\\n\\\\n1. **Correct the immediate UI state split.** Make the responsive application refresh install the returned canvas as both application ledger state and `canvasState.activeLedger`, then derive `currentCard` from that shared object.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n2. **Add a regression for the exact new-intake sequence.** Create an intake, launch Codex, complete the post-launch canvas refresh, open Codex Log, and assert that the persisted run ID renders with queued/running controls instead of the empty state.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n3. **Introduce the unified durable run manifest and migrate queue/pipeline readers.** Preserve existing card pointers as presentation references only.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n4. **Replace all three spawn paths with the detached file-descriptor launcher.** Cover thread start, continuation, and pipeline skill execution through one launch service.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n5. **Replace child callbacks with a file/OS reconciler.** Persist terminal state, retry admission, queue release, card projection changes, pipeline advancement, and notifications from idempotent manifest transitions.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n6. **Replace child-handle cancellation with validated process-group signalling.** Remove `runtime.codexSkillRuns` from status and capacity authority after parity tests pass.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n7. **Delete the adoption compatibility path after migration fixtures prove old queue records upgrade once.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## F. F. Required verification\\\\n\\\\n1. **UI consistency:** the same live run ID and lifecycle state appear in Control Room, card detail, and Codex Log before reload and after reload.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n2. **Server independence:** start a run, record JSONL growth, stop the Decision OS server, verify the same PID/start identity remains live and JSONL continues growing, restart the server, and verify status remains running without a duplicate process.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n3. **Persistence:** successful completion survives reload; a rejected launch reconciles to failed; an interrupted process becomes resumable once; queue capacity remains correct across projects.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n4. **Cancellation:** after a server restart, stop the adopted run, verify the validated process group exits, persist `cancelled`, and release capacity exactly once.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n5. **Pipeline parity:** repeat server independence and cancellation for a pipeline skill, then verify the next skill starts once after successful completion.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## G. -->\\\\n\\\\nIci tu peux voir qu'on a une grosse incohérence, c'est une tâche dans le projet Pink qui est en train de tourner, et en fait, on voit bien qu'il y a une tâche qui tourne en codex log, pourtant, il me dit qu'il n'y a pas de codex run qui est en train de tourner. Donc il faut qu'on fasse une analyse de pourquoi ça arrive, et de toute façon, je trouve qu'on a un problème majeur sur la façon dont sont spawnés les process codex, parce qu'ils sont trop dépendants du serveur. Mais en fait, ils devraient être spawnés directement sur la machine, et pas du tout en process node, ce qui permettrait du coup, au lieu de faire le piping, STDA ou vert, quelque chose qui est rattaché au serveur node, directement vers un fichier. Mais normalement on avait déjà fait un début de refacto comme ça, mais j'ai l'impression que c'est pas encore assez bon, on a encore des incohérences là-dessus, donc il faut faire une analyse profonde de comment ce système fonctionne, et comment on peut l'ingénierer d'une meilleure façon. Ouais, voilà, tu fais ça.\\\\n\\\\n# AGENT\\\\n<!-- decision-os:note {\\\\\\\"id\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"note-agent-1784212465220-c9a3ff72-db3\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"timestamp\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"2026-07-16T14:34:25.221Z\\\\\\\"} -->\\\\n\\\\n## A. Root cause\\\\n\\\\n1. **The Pink Codex run was live; the mobile thread held stale card state.** The launch persisted `codex-skill-1784211925748-5e8f0f24`, the durable queue and status API reported it running, and JSONL continued growing. The post-launch refresh updated `currentCard` but did not replace `canvasState.activeLedger`; the shared Codex Log renderer reads the latter and therefore rendered the empty state.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## B. Architecture finding\\\\n\\\\n1. **The current restart work persists PID identity but does not detach execution from the server.** Thread and pipeline launches still pipe all standard streams through Node and rely on in-memory child callbacks. Adopted thread runs lose cancellation, pipeline runs are not adopted, and lifecycle/capacity truth is split across cards, durable stores, and runtime memory.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## C. Decision\\\\n\\\\n1. **Use one durable run manifest and one host-owned detached launcher for every Codex run kind.** Bind prompt, JSONL, and log directly to files; reconcile status from manifest plus validated OS identity and terminal JSONL; signal the persisted process group for cancellation; keep the HTTP server as an API/projection consumer.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## D. Next implementation\\\\n\\\\n1. Apply the shared-ledger hydration fix and exact new-intake regression first.\\\\n\\\\n2. Migrate thread, continuation, and pipeline execution to the unified manifest/launcher/reconciler contract.\\\\n\\\\n3. Recovery limits lost work, but every original Codex process had already terminated with `SIGABRT`.\\n3. **The durable correction is one host-owned runner for every Codex run.** Codex standard input, JSONL output, and error output must bind directly to files; lifecycle and cancellation must use a durable manifest plus validated process identity; the HTTP server must not own Codex transport.\"},{\"title\":\"Verified failure chains\",\"markdown\":\"1. **Execution chain:** `runsv` owns `decision-os-server.mjs`; the launcher owns the backend child; the backend spawns a Node Codex wrapper; the wrapper spawns the Termux native binary. `start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts` still uses `stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']`, ingests stdout in Node, pipes both outputs to files, sends the prompt through Node, and settles state from child callbacks.\\n2. **Crash transition:** the backend-side stdout reader disappears; the native process reaches its next JSON write; the Termux binary treats `EPIPE` as a fatal print failure; Android records `SIGABRT` in `codex-main`. The three fresh crash records prove the same transition across two projects and three independent runs.\\n3. **Restart transition:** the service supervisor created a replacement backend, which read the existing run files and session IDs and launched continuations. The replacement PIDs prove session recovery; they do not prove that the original processes survived.\\n4. **Unresolved initiating event:** available service logs begin with replacement startup and Android logs contain no low-memory kill record for the old backend. The reason the backend exited is therefore not verified. The report does not assign that exit to tests, OOM, a signal sender, or a source change.\"},{\"title\":\"Queue and concurrent-agent findings\",\"markdown\":\"1. **Related implementation is active but not ready:** [Analyze Codex run lifecycle and status consistency](card:card-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797) has an uncommitted `codex-run-lifecycle` worktree with a new manifest, host launcher, reconciler, cancellation changes, frontend hydration changes, and `292` added plus `503` removed lines. Its focused frontend run still reported a missing `terminal-button.css` fixture, and the production server disappeared during the run.\\n2. **Queue restart recovery solved a different defect:** [Recover queued Codex runs after server restart](card:card-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c) corrected a lost scheduler wake-up for durable pending items. It does not remove server-owned pipes from running Codex processes.\\n3. **Verification admission remains incomplete:** [Make worktree verification one-command and environment-safe](card:card-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a) remains open. The live lifecycle agent invoked `node bin/decision-os-verify.mjs -- npm run test:front-back`, then `npm test --prefix frontend`. Because the wrapper sees `npm` instead of `node --test`, its concurrency rewrite does not apply; the observed workers ran with `--test-concurrency=0` while production Codex runs were active.\\n4. **The suite overlap is a proven safety defect, not a proven crash cause.** The verification lease serializes verification commands only; it does not exclude production Codex work, cap test workers hidden behind npm scripts, or protect the serving backend.\"},{\"title\":\"Selected correction\",\"markdown\":\"1. **Complete the unified host-owned runner before merging the active lifecycle branch.** Open the prompt, JSONL, and error files before spawn; start Codex in its own process session with those file descriptors; persist PID, Linux start identity, process-group ID, run kind, queue order, lifecycle revision, retry timestamp, terminal status, and exit code in one manifest.\\n2. **Replace child-handle lifecycle authority.** Reconcile manifest state from validated OS identity and terminal JSONL events; perform cancellation by signalling the validated process group; make queue release, retry admission, card projection, pipeline advancement, and notification idempotent manifest transitions.\\n3. **Harden the supervised server boundary.** Keep `runsv` as the single server owner, make readiness follow successful `listen`, record backend exit code and signal, and refuse replacement startup while another verified port owner remains.\\n4. **Make mobile verification admission enforceable.** Expand repository scripts to direct bounded test commands, reject repo-wide suites while durable Codex manifests are running, and require an operator-authorized maintenance window for the single full-suite run. The lease must terminate the complete verification process group on interruption.\\n5. **Track the Termux binary defect independently.** Report the reproducible stdout `EPIPE` abort to the Termux Codex package, pin the corrected build once available, and retain the direct-file runner so server survival never depends on that upstream fix.\"},{\"title\":\"Acceptance gate\",\"markdown\":\"1. **Server independence:** one thread run and one pipeline run continue with the same PID/start identity and growing JSONL while the Decision OS backend is absent; restart creates no duplicate process.\\n2. **Lifecycle authority:** completion, failure, cancellation, retry, capacity release, card status, and pipeline advancement each persist exactly once and survive reload.\\n3. **Mobile safety:** a repo-wide verification request is rejected while a production Codex manifest is running; direct test commands never exceed three workers; interruption leaves no verification descendants.\\n4. **Crash evidence:** Android crash logs show no new `failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe` entry during the controlled server-loss acceptance sequence.\\n5. **Merge gate:** do not merge the active lifecycle worktree until focused checks, bounded package checks, backend and frontend typechecks, the maintenance-window full suite, and served mobile status consistency all pass.\"}],\"subtasks\":[{\"title\":\"Preserve the Original Broken-Pipe RCA\",\"sections\":[{\"title\":\"Original conclusion\",\"markdown\":\"1. The report classified the recorded termination as `parent/server disappearance → closed stdout pipe → Codex writes JSON → EPIPE panic → SIGABRT`.\\n3. This subtask preserves the prior report. The server-owned Codex path pipes standard streams through Node and relies on in-memory settlement callbacks.\\n3. 7pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22subtasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Preserve%20the%20Original%20Broken-Pipe%20RCA%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D'\\\"\"} 20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22subtasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Preserve%20the%20Original%20Broken-Pipe%20RCA%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D'\"`\nStatus:
