'%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22title%22%3A%22Eliminate%20Mobile%20Codex%20Process%20Crashes%22%2C%22zoneTitle%22%3A%22Mobile%20Codex%20Runtime%20Reliability%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%2 '%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22updates%22%3A%5B%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20c s%20not%20convert%20the%20concurrent%20full%20suite%20into%20causality.%20It%20records%20the%20separate%20proven%20defect%20that%20npm-based%20suites%20bypass%20the%20three-worker%20rewrite%20and%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20during%20production%20Codex%20work.%5Cn%5Cn---%5Cn%5Cn%23%23%20B.%20Selected%20resolution%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**Finish%20one%20host-owned%2C%20direct-file%20Codex%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree.**%20Use%20one%20durable%20manifest%2C%20validated%20process-group%20cancellation%2C%20idempotent%20reconciliation%2C%20and%20no%20server-owned%20standard-stream%20pipes.%5Cn2.%20**Add%20enforceable%20mobile%20verification%20admission.**%20Reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20production%20runs%20are%20active%2C%20expose%20direct%20bounded%20commands%2C%20and%20reserve%20the%20full%20suite%20for%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window.%5Cn3.%20**Keep%20this%20master%20open.**%20Its%20acceptance%20gate%20requires%20server-independent%20thread%20and%20pipeline%20runs%2C%20exact-once%20lifecycle%20transitions%2C%20bounded%20verification%20cleanup%2C%20served%20mobile%20consistency%2C%20and%20no%20new%20Android%20broken-pipe%20crash.%22%7D'\\\"\"} '%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22updates%22%3A%5B%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%2 '%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22updates%22%3A%5B%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22master-task%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22mobile%22%2C%22codex%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22subtask%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22evidence%22%5D%7D%5D%2C%22verifiedSubtaskIds%22%3A%5B%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%5D%2C%22reply%22%3A%22%23%23%20A.%20Verified%20conclusion%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**The%20original%20RCA%20is%20now%20preserved%20in%20a%20verified%20subtask.**%20The%20master%20has%20been%20replaced%20with%20the%20cross-incident%20report%20and%20links%20the%20related%20queue%2C%20lifecycle%2C%20and%20verification%20work.%5Cn2.%20**The%20failure%20recurred%20during%20this%20audit%20across%20three%20live%20runs.**%20Android%20recorded%20three%20%60SIGABRT%60%20crashes%20with%20the%20exact%20stdout%20%60Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20message%3B%20the%20replacement%20backend%20resumed%20all%20three%20sessions%20afterward.%5Cn3.%20**The%20server%20exit%20trigger%20remains%20unverified.**%20The%20report%20does%20not%20convert%20the%20concurrent%20full%20suite%20into%20causality.%20It%20records%20the%20separate%20proven%20defect%20that%20npm-based%20suites%20bypass%20the%20three-worker%20rewrite%20and%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20during%20production%20Codex%20work.%5Cn%5Cn---%5Cn%5Cn%23%23%20B.%20Selected%20resolution%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**Finish%20one%20host-owned%2C%20direct-file%20Codex%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree.**%20Use%20one%20durable%20manifest%2C%20validated%20process-group%20cancellation%2C%20idempotent%20reconciliation%2C%20and%20no%20server-owned%20standard-stream%20pipes.%5Cn2.%20**Add%20enforceable%20mobile%20verification%20admission.**%20Reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20production%20runs%20are%20active%2C%20expose%20direct%20bounded%20commands%2C%20and%20reserve%20the%20full%20suite%20for%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window.%5Cn3.%20**Keep%20this%20master%20open.**%20Its%20acceptance%20gate%20requires%20server-independent%20thread%20and%20pipeline%20runs%2C%20exact-once%20lifecycle%20transitions%2C%20bounded%20verification%20cleanup%2C%20served%20mobile%20consistency%2C%20and%20no%20new%20Android%20broken-pipe%20crash.%22%7D'\\\"\",\"codexExitCode\":\"0\"} '%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22updates%22%3A%5B%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22master-task%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22mobile%22%2C%22codex%22%5D%7D%2C%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%2C%22labels%22%3A%5B%22subtask%22%2C%22rca%22%2C%22evidence%22%5D%7D%5D%2C%22verifiedSubtaskIds%22%3A%5B%22card-531f36de-d6cd-44e1-8cba-cf5473e47714%22%5D%2C%22reply%22%3A%22%23%23%20A.%20Verified%20conclusion%5Cn%5Cn1.%20**The%20original%20RCA%20is%20now%20preserved%20in%20a%20verified%20subtask.**%20The%20master%20has%20been%20replaced%20with%20the%20cross-incident%20report%20and%20links%20the%20related%20queue%2C%20lifecycle%2C%20and%20verification%20work.%5Cn2.%20**The%20failure%20recurred%20during%20this%20audit%20across%20three%20live%20runs.**%20Android%20recorded%20three%20%60SIGABRT%60%20crashes%20with%20the%20exact%20stdout%20%60Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20message%3B%20the%20replacement%20backend%20resumed%20all%20three%20sessions%20afterward.%5Cn3.%20**The%20server%20exit%20trigger%20remains%20unverified.**%20The%20report%20doe Operator conclusion\n\n1. **The recurring production failure is a closed Codex stdout pipe.** During this audit Android recorded three native Codex aborts at `23:27:22`, `23:27:25`, and `23:27:46` with `failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32)`. The affected processes were this RCA run, the Pink run, and the related lifecycle implementation run.\n2. **Decision OS recovered work after the damage instead of preserving execution through server loss.** The replacement backend started at `16:27:54` UTC and spawned resume processes for all three runs at `16:27:58` UTC. Every original Codex process had already terminated with `SIGABRT`.\n3. **The durable correction is one host-owned runner for every Codex run.** Codex standard input, JSONL output, and error output must bind directly to files; lifecycle and cancellation must use a durable manifest plus validated process identity; the HTTP server must not own Codex transport.\n\n---\n\n## B. Verified failure chains\n\n1. **Execution chain:** `runsv` owns `decision-os-server.mjs`; the launcher owns the backend child; the backend spawns a Node Codex wrapper; the wrapper spawns the Termux native binary. `start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts` still uses `stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe']`, ingests stdout in Node, pipes both outputs to files, sends the prompt through Node, and settles state from child callbacks.\n2. **Crash transition:** the backend-side stdout reader disappears; the native process reaches its next JSON write; the Termux binary treats `EPIPE` as a fatal print failure; Android records `SIGABRT` in `codex-main`. Three fresh crash records prove the same transition across two projects and three independent runs.\n3. **Restart transition:** the supervisor created a replacement backend, which read the run files and session IDs and launched continuations. The replacement PIDs prove recovery; the original processes did not survive.\n4. **Unresolved initiating event:** available service logs begin with replacement startup and Android logs contain no low-memory kill record for the old backend. The reason the backend exited is not verified. This report does not assign that exit to tests, OOM, a signal sender, or a source change.\n\n---\n\n## C. Queue and concurrent-agent findings\n\n1. **Related implementation is active but not ready:** [Analyze Codex run lifecycle and status consistency](card:card-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797) has an uncommitted `codex-run-lifecycle` worktree with a new manifest, host launcher, reconciler, cancellation changes, frontend hydration changes, and `292` added plus `503` removed lines. Its focused frontend run still reported a missing `terminal-button.css` fixture, and the production server disappeared during the run.\n2. **Queue restart recovery solved a different defect:** [Recover queued Codex runs after server restart](card:card-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c) corrected a lost scheduler wake-up for durable pending items. It does not remove server-owned pipes from running Codex processes.\n3. **Verification admission remains incomplete:** [Make worktree verification one-command and environment-safe](card:card-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a) remains open. The live lifecycle agent invoked `node bin/decision-os-verify.mjs -- npm run test:front-back`, then `npm test --prefix frontend`. The wrapper sees `npm`, so its concurrency rewrite does not apply; observed workers ran with `--test-concurrency=0` while production Codex runs were active.\n4. **The suite overlap is a proven safety defect, not a proven crash cause.** The lease serializes verification commands only; it does not exclude production Codex work, cap test workers hidden behind npm scripts, or protect the serving backend.\n\n---\n\n## D. Selected correction\n\n1. **Complete the unified host-owned runner before merging the active lifecycle branch.** Open the prompt, JSONL, and error files before spawn; start Codex in its own process session with those file descriptors; persist PID, Linux start identity, process-group ID, run kind, queue order, lifecycle revision, retry timestamp, terminal status, and exit code in one manifest.\n2. **Replace child-handle lifecycle authority.** Reconcile from validated OS identity and terminal JSONL; cancel through the validated process group; make queue release, retry admission, card projection, pipeline advancement, and notification idempotent manifest transitions.\n3. **Harden the supervised server boundary.** Keep `runsv` as the single owner, make readiness follow successful `listen`, record backend exit code and signal, and refuse replacement startup while another verified port owner remains.\n4. **Make mobile verification admission enforceable.** Expand repository scripts to direct bounded test commands, reject repo-wide suites while durable Codex manifests are running, and require an operator-authorized maintenance window for the single full-suite run. The lease must terminate the complete verification process group on interruption.\n5. **Track the Termux binary defect independently.** Report the reproducible stdout `EPIPE` abort, pin the corrected build once available, and retain the direct-file runner so server survival never depends on that upstream fix.\n\n---\n\n## E. Acceptance gate\n\n1. **Server independence:** one thread run and one pipeline run continue with the same PID/start identity and growing JSONL while the backend is absent; restart creates no duplicate.\n2. **Lifecycle authority:** completion, failure, cancellation, retry, capacity release, card status, and pipeline advancement each persist exactly once and survive reload.\n3. **Mobile safety:** repo-wide verification is rejected while a production Codex manifest is running; direct tests never exceed three workers; interruption leaves no verification descendants.\n4. **Crash evidence:** Android logs show no new `failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe` entry during controlled server loss.\n5. **Merge gate:** do not merge the active lifecycle worktree until focused checks, bounded package checks, both typechecks, the maintenance-window full suite, and served mobile status consistency pass.\n\n---\n\n## F. Subtasks\n\n1. At `19:36:08`, the binary emitted `failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32)` and Android recorded `Fatal signal 6 (SIGABRT)` in `codex-main`.\n\n---\n\n## C. Original contributing defects\n\n1. `decision-os-server.mjs` forwards signals only to its immediate child.\n2. The server-owned Codex path pipes standard streams through Node and relies on in-memory callbacks.\n3. Adopted thread runs lose child-handle cancellation; pipeline runs use a separate non-adopted lifecycle.\n4. Replacement startup previously collided with a stale port `50150` owner.\n5. The verification wrapper did not guarantee destruction of the complete descendant tree.\n6. Its focused frontend run still reported a missing `terminal-button.css` fixture, and the production server disappeared during the run.\\n2. **Queue restart recovery solved a different defect:** [Recover queued Codex runs after server restart](card:card-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c) corrected a lost scheduler wake-up for durable pending items. It does not remove server-owned pipes from running Codex processes.\\n3. **Verification admission remains incomplete:** [Make worktree verification one-command and environment-safe](card:card-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a) remains open. '%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22title%22%3A%22Eliminate%20Mobile%20Codex%20Process%20Crashes%22%2C%22zoneTitle%22%3A%22Mobile%20Codex%20Runtime%20Reliability%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22subtasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Preserve%20the%20Original%20Broken-Pipe%20RCA%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D'\\\"\"} 7pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Queue%20restart%20recovery%20solved%20a%20different%20defect%3A**%20%5BRecover%20queued%20Codex%20runs%20after%20server%20restart%5D(card%3Acard-b85c6294-593d-4870-8c6e-ec559386df3c)%20corrected%20a%20lost%20scheduler%20wake-up%20for%20durable%20pending%20items.%20It%20does%20not%20remove%20server-owned%20pipes%20from%20running%20Codex%20processes.%5Cn3.%20**Verification%20admission%20remains%20incomplete%3A**%20%5BMake%20worktree%20verification%20one-command%20and%20environment-safe%5D(card%3Acard-1adba778-1e57-4160-858e-e9ebfec1999a)%20remains%20open.%20The%20live%20lifecycle%20agent%20invoked%20%60node%20bin%2Fdecision-os-verify.mjs%20--%20npm%20run%20test%3Afront-back%60%2C%20then%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20frontend%60.%20The%20wrapper%20sees%20%60npm%60%2C%20so%20its%20concurrency%20rewrite%20does%20not%20apply%3B%20observed%20workers%20ran%20with%20%60--test-concurrency%3D0%60%20while%20production%20Codex%20runs%20were%20active.%5Cn4.%20**The%20suite%20overlap%20is%20a%20proven%20safety%20defect%2C%20not%20a%20proven%20crash%20cause.**%20The%20lease%20serializes%20verification%20commands%20only%3B%20it%20does%20not%20exclude%20production%20Codex%20work%2C%20cap%20test%20workers%20hidden%20behind%20npm%20scripts%2C%20or%20protect%20the%20serving%20backend.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Selected%20correction%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Complete%20the%20unified%20host-owned%20runner%20before%20merging%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20branch.**%20Open%20the%20prompt%2C%20JSONL%2C%20and%20error%20files%20before%20spawn%3B%20start%20Codex%20in%20its%20own%20process%20session%20with%20those%20file%20descriptors%3B%20persist%20PID%2C%20Linux%20start%20identity%2C%20process-group%20ID%2C%20run%20kind%2C%20queue%20order%2C%20lifecycle%20revision%2C%20retry%20timestamp%2C%20terminal%20status%2C%20and%20exit%20code%20in%20one%20manifest.%5Cn2.%20**Replace%20child-handle%20lifecycle%20authority.**%20Reconcile%20from%20validated%20OS%20identity%20and%20terminal%20JSONL%3B%20cancel%20through%20the%20validated%20process%20group%3B%20make%20queue%20release%2C%20retry%20admission%2C%20card%20projection%2C%20pipeline%20advancement%2C%20and%20notification%20idempotent%20manifest%20transitions.%5Cn3.%20**Harden%20the%20supervised%20server%20boundary.**%20Keep%20%60runsv%60%20as%20the%20single%20owner%2C%20make%20readiness%20follow%20successful%20%60listen%60%2C%20record%20backend%20exit%20code%20and%20signal%2C%20and%20refuse%20replacement%20startup%20while%20another%20verified%20port%20owner%20remains.%5Cn4.%20**Make%20mobile%20verification%20admission%20enforceable.**%20Expand%20repository%20scripts%20to%20direct%20bounded%20test%20commands%2C%20reject%20repo-wide%20suites%20while%20durable%20Codex%20manifests%20are%20running%2C%20and%20require%20an%20operator-authorized%20maintenance%20window%20for%20the%20single%20full-suite%20run.%20The%20lease%20must%20terminate%20the%20complete%20verification%20process%20group%20on%20interruption.%5Cn5.%20**Track%20the%20Termux%20binary%20defect%20independently.**%20Report%20the%20reproducible%20stdout%20%60EPIPE%60%20abort%2C%20pin%20the%20corrected%20build%20once%20available%2C%20and%20retain%20the%20direct-file%20runner%20so%20server%20survival%20never%20depends%20on%20that%20upstream%20fix.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Acceptance%20gate%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Server%20independence%3A**%20one%20thread%20run%20and%20one%20pipeline%20run%20continue%20with%20the%20same%20PID%2Fstart%20identity%20and%20growing%20JSONL%20while%20the%20backend%20is%20absent%3B%20restart%20creates%20no%20duplicate.%5Cn2.%20**Lifecycle%20authority%3A**%20completion%2C%20failure%2C%20cancellation%2C%20retry%2C%20capacity%20release%2C%20card%20status%2C%20and%20pipeline%20advancement%20each%20persist%20exactly%20once%20and%20survive%20reload.%5Cn3.%20**Mobile%20safety%3A**%20repo-wide%20verification%20is%20rejected%20while%20a%20production%20Codex%20manifest%20is%20running%3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22subtasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Preserve%20the%20Original%20Broken-Pipe%20RCA%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%20later%20wrote%20to%20a%20stdout%20pipe%20with%20no%20reader.%5Cn5.%20At%20%6019%3A36%3A08%60%2C%20the%20binary%20emitted%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60%20and%20Android%20recorded%20%60Fatal%20signal%206%20(SIGABRT)%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20contributing%20defects%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%20forwards%20signals%20only%20to%20its%20immediate%20child.%5Cn2.%20The%20server-owned%20Codex%20path%20pipes%20standard%20streams%20through%20Node%20and%20relies%20on%20in-memory%20callbacks.%5Cn3.%20Adopted%20thread%20runs%20lose%20child-handle%20cancellation%3B%20pipeline%20runs%20use%20a%20separate%20non-adopted%20lifecycle.%5Cn4.%20Replacement%20startup%20previously%20collided%20with%20a%20stale%20port%20%6050150%60%20owner.%5Cn5.%20The%20verification%20wrapper%20did%20not%20guarantee%20destruction%20of%20the%20complete%20descendant%20tree.%5Cn6.%20The%20original%20report%20recorded%20memory%20and%20swap%20pressure%20as%20an%20amplifier%20rather%20than%20the%20native%20crash%20signature.%22%7D%5D%7D%5D%7D'\"`\nStatus: %3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22subtasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Preserve%20the%20Original%20Broken-Pipe%20RCA%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%2 %3B%20direct%20tests%20never%20exceed%20three%20workers%3B%20interruption%20leaves%20no%20verification%20descendants.%5Cn4.%20**Crash%20evidence%3A**%20Android%20logs%20show%20no%20new%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%60%20entry%20during%20controlled%20server%20loss.%5Cn5.%20**Merge%20gate%3A**%20do%20not%20merge%20the%20active%20lifecycle%20worktree%20until%20focused%20checks%2C%20bounded%20package%20checks%2C%20both%20typechecks%2C%20the%20maintenance-window%20full%20suite%2C%20and%20served%20mobile%20status%20consistency%20pass.%22%7D%5D%2C%22subtasks%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Preserve%20the%20Original%20Broken-Pipe%20RCA%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20The%20agent%20crashed%20because%20its%20stdout%20consumer%20disappeared%2C%20and%20the%20Termux%20Codex%20binary%20treats%20that%20broken-pipe%20condition%20as%20a%20fatal%20panic.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20classified%20the%20termination%20as%20%60parent%2Fserver%20disappearance%20%E2%86%92%20closed%20stdout%20pipe%20%E2%86%92%20Codex%20writes%20JSON%20%E2%86%92%20EPIPE%20panic%20%E2%86%92%20SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20This%20subtask%20preserves%20the%20prior%20report.%20The%20master%20supersedes%20its%20unverified%20attribution%20of%20the%20initiating%20server%20exit.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Original%20failure%20chain%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20At%20%6019%3A25%3A37%60%2C%20the%20agent%20launched%20%60npm%20test%20--prefix%20backend%60.%5Cn2.%20The%20report%20stated%20that%20the%20suite%20left%20a%20large%20test%20tree%20running%2C%20another%20verification%20started%2C%20and%20a%20worktree%20was%20removed%20while%20a%20process%20still%20had%20%60cwd%3D.worktrees%2Fjson-master-projection%2Fbackend%20(deleted)%60.%5Cn3.%20At%20%6019%3A27%3A52%60%2C%20replacement%20servers%20repeatedly%20failed%20with%20%60EADDRINUSE%60%20on%20%60127.0.0.1%3A50150%60.%5Cn4.%20Codex%20PID%20%6021194%60%20became%20parented%20by%20PID%20%601%60%20and%2 '%7B%22masterCardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22updates%22%3A%5B%7B%22cardId%22%3A%22card-ae7bb1da-08b9-4f79-83e0-b0586afada7b%22%2C%22sections%22%3A%5B%7B%22title%22%3A%22Operator%20conclusion%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**The%20recurring%20production%20failure%20is%20a%20closed%20Codex%20stdout%20pipe.**%20During%20this%20audit%20Android%20recorded%20three%20native%20Codex%20aborts%20at%20%6023%3A27%3A22%60%2C%20%6023%3A27%3A25%60%2C%20and%20%6023%3A27%3A46%60%20with%20%60failed%20printing%20to%20stdout%3A%20Broken%20pipe%20(os%20error%2032)%60.%20The%20affected%20processes%20were%20this%20RCA%20run%2C%20the%20Pink%20run%2C%20and%20the%20related%20lifecycle%20implementation%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Decision%20OS%20recovered%20work%20after%20the%20damage%20instead%20of%20preserving%20execution%20through%20server%20loss.**%20The%20replacement%20backend%20started%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A54%60%20UTC%20and%20spawned%20resume%20processes%20for%20all%20three%20runs%20at%20%6016%3A27%3A58%60%20UTC.%20Every%20original%20Codex%20process%20had%20already%20terminated%20with%20%60SIGABRT%60.%5Cn3.%20**The%20durable%20correction%20is%20one%20host-owned%20runner%20for%20every%20Codex%20run.**%20Codex%20standard%20input%2C%20JSONL%20output%2C%20and%20error%20output%20must%20bind%20directly%20to%20files%3B%20lifecycle%20and%20cancellation%20must%20use%20a%20durable%20manifest%20plus%20validated%20process%20identity%3B%20the%20HTTP%20server%20must%20not%20own%20Codex%20transport.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Verified%20failure%20chains%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Execution%20chain%3A**%20%60runsv%60%20owns%20%60decision-os-server.mjs%60%3B%20the%20launcher%20owns%20the%20backend%20child%3B%20the%20backend%20spawns%20a%20Node%20Codex%20wrapper%3B%20the%20wrapper%20spawns%20the%20Termux%20native%20binary.%20%60start-thread-codex-process-controller.ts%60%20still%20uses%20%60stdio%3A%20%5B%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%2C%27pipe%27%5D%60%2C%20ingests%20stdout%20in%20Node%2C%20pipes%20both%20outputs%20to%20files%2C%20sends%20the%20prompt%20through%20Node%2C%20and%20settles%20state%20from%20child%20callbacks.%5Cn2.%20**Crash%20transition%3A**%20the%20backend-side%20stdout%20reader%20disappears%3B%20the%20native%20process%20reaches%20its%20next%20JSON%20write%3B%20the%20Termux%20binary%20treats%20%60EPIPE%60%20as%20a%20fatal%20print%20failure%3B%20Android%20records%20%60SIGABRT%60%20in%20%60codex-main%60.%20Three%20fresh%20crash%20records%20prove%20the%20same%20transition%20across%20two%20projects%20and%20three%20independent%20runs.%5Cn3.%20**Restart%20transition%3A**%20the%20supervisor%20created%20a%20replacement%20backend%2C%20which%20read%20the%20run%20files%20and%20session%20IDs%20and%20launched%20continuations.%20The%20replacement%20PIDs%20prove%20recovery%3B%20the%20original%20processes%20did%20not%20survive.%5Cn4.%20**Unresolved%20initiating%20event%3A**%20available%20service%20logs%20begin%20with%20replacement%20startup%20and%20Android%20logs%20contain%20no%20low-memory%20kill%20record%20for%20the%20old%20backend.%20The%20reason%20the%20backend%20exited%20is%20not%20verified.%20This%20report%20does%20not%20assign%20that%20exit%20to%20tests%2C%20OOM%2C%20a%20signal%20sender%2C%20or%20a%20source%20change.%22%7D%2C%7B%22title%22%3A%22Queue%20and%20concurrent-agent%20findings%22%2C%22markdown%22%3A%221.%20**Related%20implementation%20is%20active%20but%20not%20ready%3A**%20%5BAnalyze%20Codex%20run%20lifecycle%20and%20status%20consistency%5D(card%3Acard-f6904e45-8e15-4691-9619-b17165567797)%20has%20an%20uncommitted%20%60codex-run-lifecycle%60%20worktree%20with%20a%20new%20manifest%2C%20host%20launcher%2C%20reconciler%2C%20cancellation%20changes%2C%20frontend%20hydration%20changes%2C%20and%20%60292%60%20added%20plus%20%60503%60%20removed%20lines.%20Its%20focused%20frontend%20run%20still%20reported%20a%20missing%20%60terminal-button.css%60%20fixture%2C%20and%20the%20production%20server%20disappeared%20during%20the%20run.%5Cn2.%20**Qu
